method: Actual registered React Water Cycle module in an owned localhost fixture. Native parent/child details, buttons, keyboard activation, groundwater Check investigation and observation writing. Frozen baseline receives the same saved state and old navigation/writing controls. All three head setups and nine prediction outcomes are read from the mounted renderer. No copied markup or manufactured results.

wcQuiz.q: How does most groundwater move through soil and rock?

wrongFeedback.Open underground rivers: Most groundwater moves through pores and cracks, rather than open rivers.

wcMyth.s: Groundwater flows in big underground rivers and lakes.
wcMyth.why: Almost all groundwater seeps through tiny pores in soil and rock, like water held in a sponge.
wcMyth.tryIt: In Journey Mode, take the Infiltration path: the aquifer leg is the slowest part of the cycle.
